description: This file defines an interface 'SettableRefreshTokenInterface' in the 'League\OAuth2\Client\Token' namespace. It declares a method for setting or replacing a refresh token, serving as a contract for implementing classes to handle refresh tokens in an OAuth2 client library.

classes.name: SettableRefreshTokenInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares a method for setting a refresh token, to be implemented by classes managing OAuth2 refresh tokens.

methods.name: setRefreshToken
methods.description: Sets or replaces the refresh token with the provided token.
